import json,urllib.request,time
K="sk-obs1_udskmDLZSCubLF6r8w38mAAAAABl9irHX-OTsRdUIAUEPl_-rRuDcV_Imbs"
M="deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-abliterated:thinking"
tools=[{"type":"function","function":{"name":"bash","description":"Run shell","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"command":{"type":"string"}},"required":["command"]}}}]
ok=0; times=[]; costs=0; empties=0
for i in range(5):
    p={"model":M,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an AI agent. Use tools when needed."},
        {"role":"user","content":f"List isi folder /tmp. Percobaan {i+1}."}],
       "tools":tools,"max_tokens":2000}
    r=urllib.request.Request("https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions",data=json.dumps(p).encode(),
      headers={"Authorization":f"Bearer {K}","Content-Type":"application/json"})
    t0=time.time()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=240) as x: d=json.load(x)
        el=time.time()-t0; times.append(el)
        m=d['choices'][0]['message']; tc=bool(m.get('tool_calls')); c=(m.get('content') or '').strip()
        costs+=d['usage']['cost']
        if tc: ok+=1
        if not c and not tc: empties+=1
        print(f"  [{i+1}] {el:5.1f}s tool_call={'YA' if tc else 'tidak':5} content={'ada' if c else 'kosong':6} ${d['usage']['cost']:.6f}")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print(f"  [{i+1}] HTTP{e.code} {e.read().decode()[:60]}")
    except Exception as e: print(f"  [{i+1}] ERR {type(e).__name__}")
print(f"\ntool_call berhasil: {ok}/5 | rata2 waktu: {sum(times)/len(times):.1f}s | total ${costs:.5f}")
PY
